40188.title: Export API rate limit proposal
40188.body:
## Proposal

Cap the export API at 60 requests per minute per tenant, with a burst allowance of 120. Tenants over the cap get HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

## Why

Three of the last four export incidents were a single tenant saturating the worker pool. A per-tenant cap isolates them without slowing everyone else.

## Rollout

Shadow mode for two weeks, logging would-be rejections, then enforce.
